name: gan-agent
description: GAN-style autonomy loop: generator mutates prompts, discriminator evaluates improvement, loop self-refines

documentation.quickstart: Run: cd modules/gan-agent && npm run autonomy "<task>" <cycles>. Uses mock LLM by default. Set OPENROUTER_API_KEY and connect to baml-openrouter for live runs.
documentation.integration: Depends on baml-openrouter for live LLM calls; logs to logs/autonomy/
documentation.status: mock LLM — real BAML integration pending

metadata.activeWorkItem: Connect to baml-openrouter BAML client for live runs
